gloss: original plan; draft proposal; original concept

definitions.explanation: The initial version of a plan, bill, or proposal before revisions are made. Common in legislative and organizational contexts.
The original idea or story that a creative work (manga, anime, film) is based on, credited to the person who conceived it.

examples.japanese: {原案|げんあん}どおりに{可決|かけつ}された。
examples.english: It was passed as per the original proposal.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}が{原案|げんあん}を{修正|しゅうせい}した。
examples.english: The committee revised the draft proposal.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}の{原案|げんあん}は{大幅|おおはば}に{変更|へんこう}されてから{成立|せいりつ}した。
examples.english: The original draft of the bill was significantly changed before it was enacted.

examples.japanese: {原案|げんあん}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{小説家|しょうせつか}だ。
examples.english: The original concept is by a famous novelist.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{原案|げんあん}は{実話|じつわ}に{基|もと}づいている。
examples.english: The original concept for this film is based on a true story.

examples.japanese: {原案|げんあん}と{脚本|きゃくほん}は{別|べつ}の{人|ひと}が{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: The original concept and the screenplay are handled by different people.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{原案|げんあん}どおり (as per the original plan)
・{原案|げんあん}を{修正|しゅうせい}する (revise the draft)
・{原案|げんあん}を{作成|さくせい}する (draw up a draft proposal)
・{原案|げんあん}を{可決|かけつ}する (pass the original proposal)

USAGE NOTES:
In legislative contexts, {原案|げんあん}どおり means the proposal was approved without changes. In creative works (manga, anime, film), {原案|げんあん} in the credits refers to the person who provided the original concept or story idea, distinct from {原作|げんさく} which means the original complete work that was adapted.
